about: Track jacket (track-jacket-textured.glb, RUGBYV 2026-11-20): coloured from the same garment split into 12 parts by Tripo (track-jacket-parts.glb) by viewer/tripo-glbparts.mjs: body and sleeves the print (Main; the sleeves' print places laid on the made jacket's sleeves); the stand collar the Collar colour area (else Main); the rib cuffs and hem band the Cuffs colour area (else Main); the zip and the pocket openings the Zip colour area (else Secondary); linings as the cloth behind them.
